question: Across a set of representative unclassified EW scenarios, does the Tableau Prep -> Server -> Desktop chain (a) ingest and normalise multi-domain, high-dimensional sensor data, (b) fuse those feeds and apply physics-based + rule-based models to derive threat-relevant intelligence, and (c) present the result to an operator in a recognisably operational surface, to a standard that lets JEWOSC judge production maturity?

matches.name: MOD JEWOSC EW Fusion
matches.project: Prep Agent / 31 - MOD JEWOSC EW Fusion Demo
matches.note: v1 of this very flow. Air picture + synthetic EOB fusion already published. Reuse its source + transform as the v2 spine.

matches.name: OpenSky US Live Air Traffic
matches.note: Same OpenSky /states/all endpoint, US bbox. Proves the live-JSON-array ingestion shape; v2 reuses the config with the UK/NW-Europe bbox (already what v1 does).

matches.name: NOAA SWPC Alerts
matches.note: Space Weather Prediction Center product feed. Candidate for the HF-propagation / EM-environment layer (F3.1).

matches.name: Active Satellite TLE Catalog
matches.note: TLE orbital elements. Candidate for the space-domain object-density layer (F3.1).

internal_scan.verdict: Strong internal footprint. v1 of this flow IS an internal DS; three sibling demo flows already prove the exact ingestion shapes v2 needs (live JSON array, product-feed JSON, paginated catalogue JSON). Internal-first satisfied: v2 builds on published assets rather than acquiring new upstreams. External reach is limited to the SAME public endpoints those internal DSes already wrap (OpenSky, SWPC, TLE mirror), keyless and auth:none.

preference_inversion.note: No inversion. This is unusual for a demo: the internal scan is genuinely load-bearing because prior demo flows already established every ingestion shape v2 requires. The external endpoints reached are the public feeds those internal DSes wrap, not net-new hosts.

indicators.name: Three+ independent feeds of different ingestion shapes fused
data_required: Periodic product-feed JSON (EM environment / space weather)

candidates.source: Published DSes: OpenSky + NOAA SWPC + TLE catalog (all on-site)
candidates.rationale: All three ingestion shapes already proven as published demo flows.
The same public endpoints the internal DSes wrap. Keyless, auth:none.

indicators.acceptance: Deliverable ingests >=3 feeds of visibly different shape; >=1 live-refreshing.

indicators.name: At least one live-snapshot feed refreshed on schedule

candidates.source: v1 MOD JEWOSC EW Fusion (already hourly)

indicators.name: Fused row carries >=25 columns across kinematics/RF/geometry/threat
data_required: v1 output schema (31 cols) + environment columns

candidates.source: environment columns added by the fusion step from the space-weather + space layers

indicators.acceptance: Produced Hyper has >=25 populated columns; QA gate confirms.

indicators.name: Air tracks correlated with a space/RF-environment layer
data_required: Per-track: an EM-environment state (HF-propagation / geomagnetic condition) applicable at snapshot time
Optional: space-object density over the theatre bbox as an environment scalar

candidates.source: NOAA SWPC Alerts DS + TLE catalog DS
candidates.rationale: Both on-site. Environment layer is low-cardinality/periodic, so it correlates as a snapshot-time scalar joined to every track rather than a per-track spatial join.

candidates.source: SWPC alerts.json (latest K-index / radio-blackout state) + TLE count over bbox

candidates.rationale: Cleaner scalar for a single em_environment_band than the free-text alerts feed.

indicators.acceptance: Each track row carries an em_environment_band (or Kp value) and a space_object_context scalar for the snapshot; both non-null.

indicators.name: Each track fused with EOB library keyed on inferred emitter class
indicators.acceptance: emitter_class + primary_emitter + rf_band + parametrics present per row.

indicators.name: Friis free-space received power (dBm) at own-ship
data_required: ERP + range + centre frequency per track
indicators.acceptance: rx_dbm present; NaN only where geometry/power legitimately absent (silent/passive).

indicators.name: Categorical threat_band from documented rule set
indicators.acceptance: threat_band in {Non-hostile,Search,Track,Engage,Critical}; thresholds documented in DS description.

indicators.name: Dashboard spec includes a PPI polar

candidates.source: dashboard artifact in v2/dashboard/ with PPI_X/PPI_Y calc definitions

indicators.acceptance: PPI construct + calcs specified in a versioned artifact.

indicators.name: Dashboard includes tactical geo + track list + RF de-interleave
data_required: lat/lon, threat_band, rx_dbm, centre_freq_ghz, pri_us, rf_band
indicators.acceptance: All three constructs specified with encodings.

indicators.name: Decision-first hierarchy with select-to-drill
indicators.acceptance: Layout ordered threat->location->identity; filter/highlight actions specified.

indicators.name: Synthetic/notional boundary declared in DS description AND on dashboard
indicators.acceptance: Disclaimer present in both places, verbatim.

preference_order_rule: INTERNAL -> DERIVED -> EXTERNAL. Internal is unusually strong: v1 of this flow plus three sibling demo DSes cover 9 of 13 indicators as GREEN-inherited. Net-new work is the environment layer (F3.1) and the versioned dashboard artifact (F6/F7/F8). External reach limited to the public endpoints the internal DSes already wrap.
approval_required_before_acquisition: External web fetch on public feeds (already-known hosts, previously approved for the sibling demo flows): opensky-network.org, services.swpc.noaa.gov, tle.ivanstanojevic.me
